The source package bundles the official `@ag-ui/core@1.0.3` and
`@ag-ui/client@1.0.3` implementations under the pinned AG-UI repository commit
recorded in `spec/provenance.json`. Their shared MIT license text is retained
in `AG-UI-MIT.txt` (SHA-256
`06dcddbb6908a0c6dd4a9e8ec822eea41d5a460a53089fecccc8a68049e99241`). The generated `dist/licenses/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` lists
the complete locked dependency set and license expressions; individual
upstream license and notice files used by the browser bundle are copied under
`dist/licenses/third-party/`.
